author: Bobby Grayson
description: The worktree carries a checked-in .deciduous/deciduous.db; a compound bash command with cd <worktree> && ... && deciduous add ... writes there. Detected via git status in the worktree.
title: Protocol slip: one deciduous call ran from the worktree cwd and wrote node 220 into the worktree's .deciduous copy; reverted with git checkout, re-added in main checkout. Always cd to main checkout first.
